objects.name: Wooden floor
moments: Rain traced crooked lines down the kitchen window while my mug of tea cooled on the wooden table.
The lamp was still on, a small yellow circle beside the blue notebook.
I cut the last slice of bread and watched the garden tree let go of one leaf at a time.
I wanted a record of the ordinary bits: warm bread, wet leaves, and a whole quiet minute before the kettle clicked.
Nothing dramatic happened.
That felt like enough to write down. #home @kitchen
